name: ProStock Auto Parts - Saddle Brook
old_description: We’re a leading supplier to the Professional Installer of auto parts and equipment in New Jersey, New York and Connecticut.
about:
ProStock Automotive operates from its corporate office in Saddle Brook, New Jersey, where it has served the tri-state automotive aftermarket for more than 30 years. The locally owned company maintains a network of 12 locations across northern New Jersey, New York, and Connecticut, including branches in East Hanover, Midland Park, Montclair, Ridgefield, Waterbury, and Totowa.

The distributor supplies professional installers with a curated selection of brand-name parts for domestic, Asian, and European vehicles, carrying lines such as Denso, Bosch, Gates, Moog, and Delco. A company-owned fleet of GPS-tracked vehicles runs on a dispatched delivery system, staffed by long-tenured drivers who provide consistent daily service to repair shops. Counter operations are handled by more than 25 specialists, each averaging two decades of experience, supported by 24/7 online ordering through ACDelco Connect, NexPart, Parts Tech, and the company's own WebLink catalog.

Customers range from independent repair shops to fleet maintenance operations throughout the New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut market. The company emphasizes quality over price substitution, with buyers selecting brands to ensure installers can work with confidence. Returns are processed through a dedicated department that issues credits via fax or email within 24 hours.

Founded on the principle of "Professional service, always in stock," ProStock positions itself as large enough to offer competitive pricing and inventory depth while remaining small enough to respond to individual shop needs. The business model combines local inventory availability with digital ordering tools that allow technicians to look up parts by VIN or license plate from a smartphone.
